meta.name: Pixel Rain
meta.description: Digital rain: columns of glyph-like rects streaming downward. Each column has a stable random speed and offset; within a column the cells form a fading trail behind a bright falling head. Per-column speed and brightness scale with the spectrum band at that column's x, so loud frequencies pour faster and brighter — but luminance follows the band smoothly, never the beat. Green-on-black by default; tune the hue, column count, fall speed, and trail length. Silence slows the rain to a gentle drip and dims it.
meta.author: ViewMusic built-in
